    FAQ

    Quote questions

    What files should I send?

    Anything that shows how you work today: screenshots of the software you use, subscription invoices or bills, spreadsheets, a brief or wireframes. Rough is fine.

    Are my files kept private?

    Yes. Your files are only used to prepare your quote, are never shared with third parties, and we delete them on request.

    How long does a quote take?

    We reply within one business day. Most quotes are ready within 2 to 5 business days, after a short call if we need to understand more.

    Is the quote free?

    Yes. Quotes are free, itemised, fixed in writing, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days. There's no obligation.

    I don't have any files. Can I still ask for a quote?

    Of course. Files help, but they're optional. Just tell us what you need and we'll take it from there.
